title: Homelessvania
description:
Fight for your rights as a homeless and use the invisibility skills you have.

Be fast, be the best and get back your liberty in a brand new and fun experience full of hostile robots and danger.

The game is a SPEEDRUNNER and mini Metroidvania in two parts.

Improve your tactic, find new shortcuts to complete the map in your best time possible.

Use frequently many powerful weapons or play it in a more "stealthy" way, it's up to you!

. REPLAYABILITY: beat your own record!

. huge maps full of secrets

. tons of robotic enemies

Dont give up and use what you have:

. your magic crutch

. your hat to make high jumps and to become invisibile 

...and even 

. wall jumps

. 360° shooting

. unlimited ammo to choose: nails, granates, plasma, electricity, acid...

. collecting plastic bottles and things of value

. ground pounding 

Art as game

A cute funny platformer for the player with sense of justice!
description_short: Fight for your rights as a homeless person in this mini Metroidvania SPEEDRUNNER.
